headline: Argentine Country Risk Falls Below 900 Points as Wall Street Bounces
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator calculated by JP Morgan fell to 895 points while Global bonds recovered about 1%, coinciding with a rebound in US markets.
why: Sovereign risk spreads and bond valuations reflect international investor confidence in emerging market fiscal and debt sustainability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Argentina's country risk indicator dropped to 895 points and Global bonds recovered.
